title: trustlayer
description: FeedOracle Trust Layer - 10-tool cross-server trust: signing, anchoring, verification.
summary: FeedOracle Trust Layer - 10-tool cross-server trust: signing, anchoring, verification.
offersHint: FeedOracle Trust Layer - 10-tool cross-server trust: signing, anchoring, verification. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tooloracle.io/trust/mcp/

toolsPreview.name: verify_claim
toolsPreview.description: Verify an agent's claim against FeedOracle signed evidence. Checks if a statement (e.g. 'USDC market cap is $32B') matches live, cryptographically signed data. Returns verified/partially_verified/unverified with confidence score and recommended action.

toolsPreview.name: get_signed_fact
toolsPreview.description: WITHDRAWN (2026-08-09). This tool does not produce or verify a cryptographic signature and returns a non-success withdrawal notice. Do not rely on it for signed evidence.

toolsPreview.name: provenance_trace
toolsPreview.description: Full data provenance chain — traces every data point from external source (CoinGecko, ESMA, on-chain) through FeedOracle processing to final delivery. Each step individually hashed. Supports EU AI Act Art. 13 transparency requirements.

toolsPreview.name: freshness_guard
toolsPreview.description: Check if data is current, stale, or expired. Prevents agent decisions based on outdated information. Configurable max age threshold.

toolsPreview.name: hallucination_check
toolsPreview.description: Compare an agent's statement against ground truth evidence. Detects factual mismatches and dangerous hallucination patterns (absolute language, suspect claims). Returns evidence checks and red flags.

toolsPreview.name: verify_signature
toolsPreview.description: WITHDRAWN (2026-08-09). This tool performs no cryptographic signature verification and returns a non-success withdrawal notice. A hash comparison is not signature verification.

toolsPreview.name: confidence_gate
toolsPreview.description: Decision gate for agents: should I proceed, exercise caution, abstain, or escalate? Evaluates multi-factor confidence for a specific action type (cite, trade, report, recommend) against a threshold.

toolsPreview.name: evidence_anchor
toolsPreview.description: WITHDRAWN (2026-08-09). This tool does not submit any blockchain transaction and creates no on-chain anchor or proof; it returns a non-success withdrawal notice.

toolsPreview.name: agent_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Get trust score and reputation for an AI agent from FeedOracle KYA (Know Your Agent) system. Returns trust level (UNVERIFIED → CERTIFIED), score (0-100), and registration details.

toolsPreview.name: trust_status
toolsPreview.description: Trust Layer infrastructure health, capabilities, and component status. Shows which verification services are online and what the Trust Layer can do.
